title: Preallocate column-scan index-probe prefixes
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when column-scan aggregate index probes build index:<table>:<column>:<value>: prefixes from known component lengths.
implementation: Added column_scan_index_prefix_for_value() with explicit capacity for index:<table>:<column>:<value>:.
Replaced column-scan aggregate indexed predicate probe prefix construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: Column-scan aggregate index-probe prefix construction now reserves capacity from known component lengths while preserving indexed aggregate query behavior.
